GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_HONG_GUAN_RI.descri: Consume up to {MaxZhaoPoConsumed} [gold]Illumination Break[/gold] from the target. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {DamagePerZhaoPo} for each stack consumed. If you have at least {GuangHuiCost} [gold]Brilliance[/gold], automatically spend it to ignore up to {PierceCap} Block.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_JING_YUE_FAN_ZHAO.title: Mirror Moon Reflection
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_JING_YUE_FAN_ZHAO.descr: Gain {Block:diff()} Block and deal {Damage:diff()} damage to an enemy. From rank 7, gain {GuangHui} [gold]Brilliance[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_QI_GU.selectionScre: Choose an unparasitized normal card to receive Blood Qi.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_GU.selectionScr: Choose a normal card with no parasite or Blood Qi to receive Moon Phase.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_CHI_GU.title: Blood Pool Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_CHI_GU.description: [gold]Activate[/gold] {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses}. Gain {XueYuanPower:diff()} [gold]Blood Essence[/gold]; each point of [gold]Overflow[/gold] becomes {OverflowBlock} Block.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_PI_GU.title: Blood Skin Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_PI_GU.description: [gold]Activate[/gold] {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses}. Gain {Block:diff()} Block; may automatically pay 1 [gold]Blood Essence[/gold] for {EmpoweredBlock} more. Each [gold]Blood Skull[/gold] adds 2.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_LU_GU.title: Blood Skull Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_LU_GU.description: [gold]Activate[/gold] {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses}. Gain {Block:diff()} Block; choose up to {MaxAbsorb} [gold]Remains[/gold] to absorb. Each grants 1 [gold]Blood Skull[/gold]; at the cap, instead heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU_GU.title: Blade-Wing Blood Bat Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU_GU.descr: [gold]Activate[/gold] {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses}. Add a same-rank Blade-Wing Blood Bat; with at least 2 [gold]Remains[/gold], choose 2 to consume and add a Blade-Wing Blood Bat Swarm instead.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YI_HAI.title: Remains
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YI_HAI.description: Gain {XueYuanPower:diff()} [gold]Blood Essence[/gold]. Retain. Cannot be parasitized.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU.title: Blade-Wing Blood Bat
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times. If the initial target had Bleed, attack once more. Then apply {LiuXuePower:diff()} Bleed. Each Blood Skull adds 1 damage to every hit. Ethereal.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU_QUN.desc: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits}+2 times. If the initial target had Bleed, attack once more. After a kill, remaining hits move to the lowest-HP enemy. Then apply {LiuXuePower:diff()} Bleed to each surviving enemy hit. Each Blood Skull adds 1 damage per hit. Ethereal.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_FU_WANG.title: Blood Bat King
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_FU_WANG.description: Deal multi-hit damage. Each Remains absorbed by Blood Bat King Gu adds 2 hits; absorbing 2 enables pursuit after a kill. If the initial target had Bleed, attack once more. Each Blood Skull adds 1 damage per hit. Ethereal.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_TAI_GU.title: Blood Fetus Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_TAI_GU.description: [gold]Fusion[/gold]; [gold]Activate[/gold] {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses}; [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. Pay 2 [gold]Blood Essence[/gold] to implant [gold]Blood Fetus[/gold], losing 2 HP per missing point. It can [gold]Devour Parasite[/gold] and [gold]Hatches[/gold] at 3 [gold]Fetal Movement[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_TAI_GU.selectionScr: Choose a normal card for Blood Fetus; it may devour Blood Qi or a non-Full Moon parasite.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_FU_WANG_GU.title: Blood Bat King Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_FU_WANG_GU.descript: [gold]Activate[/gold] {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses}. Choose up to 2 [gold]Remains[/gold] to absorb, then add a same-rank Blood Bat King. Each adds 2 hits; 2 grants [gold]Pursuit[/gold]. Resolve [gold]Blood Skull[/gold] normally.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_HE_JIA_GU.title: Blood River Armor Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_HE_JIA_GU.descripti: [gold]Activate[/gold] {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses}. [gold]Blood River[/gold]: below 4 Essence, gain {LowBloodGain} Essence and {LowBlock} Block; otherwise pay 2 for {HighBlock} Block and gain half next turn. Each Blood Skull adds 2 Block.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_PIAO_LIU.title: Blood Drift
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_PIAO_LIU.descriptio: Choose an enemy as the destination. The blood tide passes through every enemy, dealing {Damage:diff()} damage and consuming up to {MaxBleedConsumed} Bleed at each stop; each consumed Bleed adds {DamagePerBleed} damage. Unconsumed Bleed flows onward and gathers at the destination.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_WAN_HAI_GUI_CHAO.title: Myriad Remains Return
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_WAN_HAI_GUI_CHAO.descri: Choose up to 3 [gold]Remains[/gold] to consume. Split a {Damage:diff()} + {DamagePerRemains} per Remains damage pool among all enemies. Gain {Block:diff()} + {BlockPerRemains} Block per Remains.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_JI.title: Blood Moon Sacrifice
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_JI.description: Choose a [gold]Blood Parasite[/gold] host. Without playing it, advance the parasite once; if it reaches its final stage, [gold]Hatch[/gold] normally.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_JI.selectionScr: Choose a card with a Blood Path parasite.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU_GU.selec: Choose a Blade-Wing Blood Bat, or spend 2 Remains to create a Blood Bat Swarm.
